proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ _ f
  have key : ∀ y : E, (∀ x, f x = inner 𝕜 y x) → InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 E y = f :=
    fun y hy => ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by
      rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, hy x]
  refine ⟨⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 E).symm f,
    fun x => (InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply).symm, fun y hy => ?_⟩, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · rw [← key y hy]
    exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 E).symm_apply_apply y).symm
  · rw [← key y hy]
    exact ((InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 E).norm_map y).symm
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : StrongDual 𝕜 E), (∃! y : E, ∀ x, f x = inner 𝕜 y x) ∧ ∀ y : E, (∀ x, f x = inner 𝕜 y x) → ‖y‖ = ‖f‖
